name: Ham, Cheese & Potato Soup with Honey Mustard Pear-Spinach Salad
ingredients: 40 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
⅔ cup shredded cheese, Italian blend
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Cut potatoes into quarters, then slice into ⅛-inch thick pieces. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, Italian seasoning, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Add potatoes and broth to the pot. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
While the soup is heating, small dice ham.
Once the soup is simmering, add ham, stir to combine, and simmer until potatoes are fork-tender, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, quarter, core, and thinly slice pears. Place in the reserved bowl.

When the potatoes are tender, add cream and cheese; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the cheese is melted and soup is heated through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Add spinach and dressing to the bowl with the pear. Toss to combine the salad.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
